contract: GET /api/libraries/:id/episode-downloads answers the podcast episode download queue of that library as {currentDownload, queue}.
exceptions: normal, error and edge facets are covered by the listed scenarios.

The response is served through ApiCacheManager (server/managers/ApiCacheManager.js:83-118); an in-memory episode queue change does not clear that cache, so a repeated GET of the same URL can return a stale body until a database write clears it. Scenarios read the live response and the caching behaviour itself is not asserted.

invariants.contract: GET /api/libraries/:id/episode-downloads answers 200 with currentDownload being the running download of that library (or null) and queue listing that library's waiting downloads in queue order; each download object has id, episodeDisplayTitle, url, libraryItemId, libraryId, isFinished, failed, appendRandomId, startedAt, createdAt, finishedAt, podcastTitle, podcastExplicit, season, episode, episodeType, publishedAt and guid, and the queue is empty when nothing runs or waits.

GET /api/libraries/:id/episode-downloads answers 401 without a token, 403 for a user without access to the library, 404 for an unknown library, 400 for a negative limit or a fractional page, and 200 with the coerced limit 0 for a non-numeric limit; a rejected request changes no row.
